verdict.rationale: Crossmint enables agents to act autonomously within delegated, scoped permissions (spend caps, counterparties, time windows) with 'no user prompt per action', and webhooks let apps react to background events like transfers or order status — but this autonomy is scoped strictly to payment/wallet operations, not general-purpose scheduled or event-triggered automations across arbitrary tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of a general automation/scheduling engine, non-payment trigger types, or persistent background job orchestration beyond payment flows.
